description: 新竹市國中小、高中職校園周邊人行道、校門口及家長等候區全面禁菸-學校名冊 [cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新竹市衛生局. 新竹市國中小、高中職校園周邊人行道、校門口及家長等候區全面禁菸-學校名冊(學校名稱、禁菸場所地址). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 新竹市衛生局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
